# OpenI Hub

> AI-powered open innovation marketplace. Search 575,000+ startups in plain
> English, post innovation challenges, and connect directly with corporates,
> investors, government, academia and service providers. Built and operated by
> OpenI Partners LLP (India). ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified. Free to start.

## Key facts
- 575,000+ enriched startup profiles, grouped into 200 AI clusters
- 8-vector AI evaluation framework scores every startup match with explanations,
  red flags, and recommended next steps
- Semantic, plain-English search (e.g. "Series A deeptech healthcare in Bangalore")
- 11 user roles: Startup, Student, Academia, Corporate, Government, Investor,
  Mentor, Lab, Incubator, Accelerator, Service Provider
- Pricing (exclusive of 18% GST): Free; Pro ₹2,499/month; Enterprise ₹9,999/month
- Security: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, full audit trails

## What you can do on OpenI Hub
- Corporates: post open-innovation challenges and discover startups to solve them
- Investors: source and evaluate deal flow using the 8-vector framework
- Startups: get discovered, apply to challenges, and connect with partners
- Incubators & accelerators: run programs and track portfolio health over time
